data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘mamana’ which means ‘to love’, ‘to cherish’. The name Momina is a term of endearment, indicating one who is loved and cherished. In Islamic spirituality, it symbolizes the bond between the servant and God, where the servant is Momin (believer) and Allah is Momin (Forbearing, Loving). The name Momina carries the meaning “Beloved, Dear One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Momina usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved, dear one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
